Since your goal is to minimize repetition, you want the numerator (repetition under the ground-truth prefix) to stay low relative to the denominator (repetition under the model's own prefix). Conversely, a smaller ratio indicates the ground-truth condition is keeping repetition down, so a lower value is better. ( [ { ( [ in short: small ratio → good, large ratio → bad ] ) } ] )
